title: Anton and Letters
statement_md:
A set of lowercase letters is written as `{a, b, c}` (comma-space separated, wrapped in curly braces; possibly with duplicates, possibly empty `{}`). Count the distinct letters.

**Input**
One line: the set, at most 1000 characters, starting with `{` and ending with `}`.

**Output**
A single integer: the number of distinct letters.
